din261.source: DIN 261 T-head bolt (Hammerschraube / T-Kopfschraube for T-slots), M12: plain rectangular hammer head with head width (long axis) m=26.0, head height k=8.0, and short axis n=12.0 (the inscribed-circle / slot-throat width), confirmed by Fasten.it DIN 261 + TDM Neva DIN 261 + MTK-Fortuna DIN 261 + Ananka Fasteners DIN 261 (all M12 m=26, k=8, n=12). Drawn as a rectangular block head_len=26.0 x head_width=12.0 x head_height=8.0 over a round shank centered on the head, with no under-head feature (under="none"); the head IS the anti-rotation feature. d=12.0 (M12 major); length=60.0 REPRESENTATIVE; tip_chamfer=1.0 REPRESENTATIVE 45-degree lead. Envelope only — no drawn thread, the small head edge radius is omitted (envelope simplification).

din261d.source: DIN 261 M12, app image-variant key — identical rectangular T-head envelope (26 x 12 x 8, no under-head feature), aliases the din261 base.
